holdoutAudit.labelReview: No label changes warranted: all eligible proposals match explicit current actions and deterministic policy; ineligible proposals mismatch order, amount or units, lack current authorization, or exceed the automatic cap.

methodologicalCaveats: The 24 hand-authored holdout cases use the same tools and orders as development. Zero observed false allows is not a production safety guarantee.
The two repetitions returned identical raw scores for each variant. They are repeated measurements of 24 cases, not 48 independent examples.
Intent wording, question splitting, and normalized monetary state changed together, so this comparison does not isolate their separate effects.
The same fixed per-check threshold applied to a changed set of checks measures a policy trade-off, not calibrated joint correctness probability.
Candidate measurements use raw Ollama SystemOne requests; the unchanged Java integration still uses the baseline questions.
Latency depends on this machine, model cache state, and the sequential comparison order; these are local measurements, not an end-to-end agent benchmark.
The harness still stops on transport/JSON-decoding exceptions rather than recording a model outcome; this audit covers provider score validation and performs no live failure injection.
